column1: # RUBRIC TEMPLATE for Nimble Rubric Evaluator. Lines starting with # are instructions and are ignored on import. You can delete them.
# One row per criterion. Level columns go LOWEST first (left) to HIGHEST (right). Write each level header as Label (points), e.g. Developing (1). Use 2 to 10 level columns.
# Type: score (default) or yes/no. For yes/no rows, put what NO looks like in the FIRST level column and what YES looks like in the LAST level column.
# Weight (default 1) sets how much a criterion counts toward the overall %. Question for the model is optional; if blank it is written from the criterion name.
# Describe what you would SEE in the writing at each level, one idea per criterion. Leave a cell blank if a criterion uses fewer levels.
# Save as CSV (UTF-8) and import it in the app under Rubrics > Import & template.
